physicalNotes: Radius 0.28075702 Jupiter radii from Luque et al. 2025 (2025A&A...704A.174L), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...704A.174L/abstract): 20,071.9 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. GM from the mass 0.06324167 Jupiter masses (Luque et al. 2025, the mass the NASA Exoplanet Archive's composite table adopts (2025A&A...704A.174L), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive, https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...704A.174L/abstract) times JPL's Jupiter GM.
